headline: UK PM Keir Starmer resigns. And, US and Iran agree to roadmap for final deal
context: British Prime Minister Keir Starmer announced his resignation on Monday. And, the U.S. and Iran have agreed to a "roadmap" to reach a final deal within 60 days.

sources.name: NPR
